scope: Design feasibility input only; no source implementation or platform support claim
recommendations: Canonical account-database-derived paths on a supported local filesystem; no HOME, XDG, per-install, or protocol-version domain split
SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE atomically owns strict FIFO admission, slots/jobs, memory/exclusivity, checkout lifetime, and named-resource leases
One registered session/group-leading guard per admitted job; private inherited control channel; no persistent daemon
Guard registers durable group ownership before repository execution; failed registration revocation prevents late launch

Guard records provisional facts then drains/exits; caller proves group absence, finalizes artifacts/baseline while lease remains charged, then releases; dead-caller recovery never promotes provisional success
Recovery never sends terminating signals to a stored PID or PGID; parent-only SIGKILL leaves live work charged
Explicit cooperative-process-group capability; daemonizers and unobserved escaped descendants are outside support
Real candidate CLI subprocesses use explicit private fixture domains inside outer ptest tests
critical_limit: Portable process groups/psutil cannot prove or terminate every arbitrary escaped descendant. Hard arbitrary containment would require a separate platform/authority decision. Observed ambiguous escape keeps capacity charged.

proposed_defaults.unknown_memory_policy: One-worker exclusive run; estimate remains unknown

remaining_gates: Reviewed frozen design and platform/version matrix
Real Linux and macOS guard, signal, crash, nesting, and fixture-domain evidence
Filesystem capability validation and corruption/identity checks
